Hello Arjun,

I have looked at the two payments on your account. Payment 201 of ₹999 settled on 2 June against order ORD-1876 for your annual Pro renewal, and payment 202 of ₹1,499 settled on 11 August against order ORD-2340 for five extra seats. They are two separate purchases, seventy days apart, for two different amounts, so neither of them is a duplicate of the other.

A high priority ticket has been opened for a colleague to review this anyway.
